# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

**DISCLAIMER**: The study is currently undergoing peer-review. Therefore, the code base is under active development. It includes code for all data presented in the manuscript but also exploratory data analysis parts. File paths have to be adjusted by the user. 

# Image artefact correction 

Here, we correct observed image artefacts before proceeding with downstream analysis such as single-cell segmentation (see `RCC_steinbock_prepro.md`). 

## Software requirements

```{r lib, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#Data containers
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

#Data processing
library(CATALYST)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(imcRtools)

#Data visualization
library(cytomapper)
library(dittoSeq)
library(viridis)

#Utilities
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)
library(BiocParallel)
```

## Read in uncorrected images

```{r read-images}
#Load images
images <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img/",on_disk = TRUE,h5FilesPath = "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img/",BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 14,progressbar = TRUE,stop.on.error = FALSE))
```

```{r}
# Set channel-names for multi-channel images
panel <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/panel.csv")
channelNames(images) <- panel$clean_target
images
```

## Save uncorrected images


## Images with artefacts (Test code)

```{r}
library(cytomapper)
library(EBImage)

#Test image artefacts: 
#202207_TMA224.1_BlockB_SE_106.tiff
#202207_TMA224.1_BlockA_SE_075.tiff
#202207_TMA224.1_BlockB_SE_069.tiff

cur_img <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img/202207_TMA224.1_BlockB_SE_069.tiff")
channelNames(cur_img) <- paste0("ch", 1:dim(cur_img[[1]])[3])

# Visualize artefacts
plotPixels(cur_img, colour_by = "ch1", bcg = list(ch1 = c(0, 10, 1)))
plotPixels(cur_img, colour_by = "ch2", bcg = list(ch2 = c(0, 10, 1)))
plotPixels(cur_img, colour_by = "ch10", bcg = list(ch10 = c(0, 10, 1)))

# Step 1: Detect artefacts by log-variance-mean-ratio
cur_var <- apply(as.array(cur_img[[1]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), var)
cur_mean <- apply(as.array(cur_img[[1]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), mean)
cur_median <- apply(as.array(cur_img[[1]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), mean)

plot(log(cur_mean), log((cur_var)^2/cur_mean)) #Index of dispersion

plot(log(cur_mean), log(cur_var/cur_mean^2)) #log-variance-mean-ratio
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

max(cur_median)

hist(cur_median, ylim = c(0,2000))
hist(cur_median)

abline(v = 15, col = "red")

pixels_wrong_2 <- cur_median > 15
pixels_wrong_2[is.na(pixels_wrong_2)] <- FALSE

pixels_wrong <- log(cur_var/(cur_mean^2)) < 0
pixels_wrong[is.na(pixels_wrong)] <- FALSE

sum(pixels_wrong_2)
sum(pixels_wrong)

if(sum(pixels_wrong) > 0){
  print(paste0(names(cur_img),": This image contained ", sum(pixels_wrong), " artificial pixels."))
}

display(pixels_wrong)

# Step 2: Set all artificial pixels to 0
img_1 <- cur_img[[1]]
img_1[pixels_wrong] <- 0

display(img_1)

# Step 3: Replace artificial pixels by median
img_median <- medianFilter(img_1, size = 2)

img_1[test_img] <- img_median[test_img]

display(img_1)

```


## Function to remove artificial pixels

Please note that this function returns multi-channel images as **16-bit** encoded images (not 32bit as usual).

```{r}
library(BiocNeighbors)
library(BiocParallel)
library(tidyverse)
library(EBImage)

removePixelArtifacts <- function(images,
                         cutoff = 0,
                         size = 2,
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam()){
  bplapply(seq_along(images), function(x){ 
    
    # Step 1: Detect artifacts by log-variance-mean-ratio
    cur_var <- apply(as.array(images[[x]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), var)
    cur_mean <- apply(as.array(images[[x]]), MARGIN = c(1,2), mean)
    
    pixels_wrong <- log(cur_var/(cur_mean^2)) < cutoff
    pixels_wrong[is.na(pixels_wrong)] <- FALSE

    if (sum(pixels_wrong) > 0) {
      print(paste0(names(images[x]),": This image contained ", sum(pixels_wrong), " artificial pixels."))
    
    # Step 2: Set all artificial pixels to 0
    img_cor <- CytoImageList(images[x], on_disk = FALSE)[[1]] #Load images into memory
    img_cor[pixels_wrong] <- 0

    #Step 3: Replace artificial pixels with median filter 
    img_median <- medianFilter(img_cor, size = size)
    img_cor[pixels_wrong] <- img_median[pixels_wrong]

    writeImage(as.array(img_cor)/(2^16 - 1), 
               paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img_cor/",names(images[x]), ".tiff"), #directory currently hard-coded - has to be created
               bits.per.sample = 16)
    
    }else{
      
      writeImage(as.array(images[[x]])/(2^16 - 1), 
                 paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img_cor/",names(images[x]), ".tiff"),#directory currently hard-coded - has to be created
                 bits.per.sample = 16)
      
    }
    }, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)
  
  return(print("Artificial Pixel removal completed."))
  }
```

## Apply function to images 

```{r}
# Read in images 
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/images_before_correction.rds")
```


```{r}
# Run function across all images
removePixelArtifacts(images, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 20)) #please copy the function print out into an excel file
```

```{r}
# Summary for pixel removal part
library(readxl)
out <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/summary_pixelremoval.xlsx") # created by coyping the function print out into excel 

out$Image <- str_replace(out$Image, ":", "")
out$Image <- str_replace(out$Image, "\"", "")

dim(out %>% filter(n_pixels_changed >= 100)) 

hist(out$n_pixels_changed, breaks = 20)
```


## Load and save corrected images 

```{r read-images}
#Load images
images_new <- loadImages("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img_cor/",
                         on_disk = TRUE,h5FilesPath = "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/img_cor_h5/", #create separate h5_folder
                         as.is = TRUE, # Important to not rescale 16-bit images
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 25,progressbar = TRUE,stop.on.error = FALSE))
```

```{r}
# Set channel-names for multi-channel images
panel <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/panel.csv")
channelNames(images_new) <- panel$clean_target
images_new
```

```{r save-objects-read-data}
saveRDS(images_new, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
```
